- Documentation fully rewritten in Chinese, with improved structure and step-by-step usage instructions.
- New section details directory structure for templates and temp files.

OpenClaw 11-in-1 Visual Automation Suite 1.0.0

- Initial release with 11 integrated visual automation modules for Windows 10/11.
- Provides full-process computer vision tasks: screenshot, OCR, template matching, mouse/keyboard emulation, task combination, and looping.
- Includes detailed setup and usage documentation.
- Supports flexible task creation, variable inheritance, and permanent skill saving.
- One-time purchase required for access; commercial use requires additional authorization.
